details:
This update for virtiofsd fixes the following issue:

- CVE-2026-25727: time: parsing of user-provided input by the RFC 2822 date parser can lead to stack exhaustion
  (bsc#1257912).

Changes for virtiofsd:

 * Update the time crate (bsc#1257912, CVE-2026-25727)
 * Add command line options for UID/GID translation (bsc#1283239)
 * PassthroughFs: Add IdMap structures (bsc#1283239)
 * Add host/guest UID/GID translation code (bsc#1283239)
 * Custom UID/GID mapping for Attr (bsc#1283239)
 * Add UID/GID mapping functions to PassthroughFs (bsc#1283239)
 * Use explicit UID/GID types (bsc#1283239)
 * Introduce explicit UID/GID types (bsc#1283239)
 * Use SetattrIn without conversion (bsc#1283239)
 * Use fuse::Attr in FileSystem interfaces (bsc#1283239)
